entries.450d2f27124fa3f3: As its management philosophy, the company upholds the founding spirit, "Let us, through a comradely union, build a company with romance that will not collapse, a company that can contribute to society," and practices the spirit of "Shiho-yoshi" (good in four directions), its code of conduct. As its basic policy toward sustainable growth, the company works on promoting a business model that accurately captures diversifying and segmenting consumer needs and wins the No.1 share in niche markets, and at its core it places the long-term vision concept "¥10 Billion, 30 Business Divisions," which positions a scale of ¥10 billion in net sales per 1 business division as the optimal management unit. As its management policy from April 2026, the company sets out "building a company that keeps growing and will not collapse, of which there are not 2 in the world."
